context.transcript:
Looking for ways to get into better shape this year? ® Why
not join Nelson's Gym? We have all the sports and exercise
equipment you could need. There's no need to make an
appointment®stop by any of our locations between twelve
noon and three P.M., and one of our fitness experts will give
you a personalized tour of the facility. And if two people
sign up together, you'll both get fifteen percent off your
annual membership fees. So bring a friend, and register
today!
